text:
Patrick Kane came back to Chicago, and the role is different. He's 38, the veteran carrying a letter on a young team (The Athletic's Mark Lazerus noted he was the only Blackhawk wearing one in Seattle), and a Yahoo Sports headline says he's "thriving in mentor role." On the ice he's mostly a passer: 18 points in 22 games, 16 of them assists, and a six-game point streak with eight helpers. The line with Frank Nazar and Oliver Moore has been one of the league's better possession trios, by Scott Powers' count.

His shooting has gone cold. Two goals on 5.9 expected, 4.3% on his shots, is well below what his chances deserve, and that usually turns. The other worry: Lazerus reported Kane blocked a shot late in the Nov. 25 game in Seattle and went for imaging after the game, walking on his own. Our numbers project 62 points. Watch the injury news first, then whether the goals start to follow the looks.
headline: Patrick Kane, back home, is a setup man now
